posts.name: Matthew
posts.cooked:
Hi, How can I add a column to the invoice table for Markup, I see an option for Margin and Discount.

I want a column that allows me to enter in a Markup percent on an Item and add it to the final price of that item. Similar to how discount works but instead add the Markup.

The Markup should not be on the final invoice to send, only for user input during creating the invoice.

posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @mrea

You can use Margin and Discount and add or subtract anything in item price.

if you want to add Markup then Margin field can serve the purpose where you can only change the label of the filed and it will start looking / acting like Markup and add up any additional charges to your pre set item prices for each line item.

Nevertheless, pricing rule can automate Markup Factors as well.
